Design a detailed implementation plan for a new feature in a two-repo project: frontend at C:\Users\jotac\OneDrive\Documents\DEV\deliveryhub_white_label (React/Vite), backend (NestJS) at C:\Users\jotac\OneDrive\Documents\DEV\deliveryhub_white_label\server_delivery (also independently checked out at C:\Users\jotac\OneDrive\Documents\DEV\serer_delivery — same code, must be kept byte-identical; plan changes once, apply-twice is understood separately, you don't need to plan for the duplication mechanics). Supabase migrations live in the frontend repo under supabase/migrations/.

## Goal (confirmed with user via clarifying questions)

1. Rename the sidebar label "Relatórios" → "Conferências" (cosmetic, no route change).
2. Build a restaurant-side "Motoboy" report page, mirroring the existing "Garçom" report exactly in structure and feature parity, INCLUDING a full repasse (payout) flow with cash/PIX split, caixa (cash register) integration, and estorno (reversal).
3. On the motoboy's own mobile portal, expand/rename the existing "Ganhos" tab into "Financeiro", adding a daily production view (today's earnings, deliveries count, day-by-day breakdown). NO self-conference/acceptance step for the motoboy (decided: simpler read-only view, unlike garçom's turno-conference mechanism — skip that entirely).

## What already exists (I've already read this code directly, use it as ground truth — do not need to re-explore, just design against it)

### Garçom report — the pattern to mirror
- Frontend: `src/pages/restaurante-relatorios/Garcom.jsx` (488 lines) — full report page: period filter, per-garçom summary table (total_vendido, total_comissao, total_gorjeta, comandas_abertas/pendentes, produto favorito), "Detalhamento das Vendas" (order-by-order conference table), "Repasse" modal (splits payout amount between dinheiro/pix), estorno button, print button (`buildPrintHtml` + `printIframe` from `src/utils/relatorioPrint.js`).
- Nav: `src/pages/restaurante-relatorios/RelatorioNav.jsx` — `SUBLINKS` array (lines 6-11) hardcodes 4 links (Menu Relatórios, Garçom, Financeiro, Produtos), highlights active by `window.location.pathname`.
- Index: `src/pages/restaurante-relatorios/index.jsx` — `RELATORIOS` array (lines 6-31), 3 cards (garcom/financeiro/produtos) linking to sub-routes.
- Routes: `src/Routes.jsx:133-136` — `/restaurante/relatorios`, `/restaurante/relatorios/garcom`, `/restaurante/relatorios/financeiro`, `/restaurante/relatorios/produtos`.
- Frontend service calls: `src/services/restauranteService.js:184-188`:
  ```js
  getRelatorioGarcom(de, ate)                    -> GET /relatorio/garcom?de=&ate=
  registrarRepasseGarcom(garcomId, data)          -> POST /relatorio/garcom/:garcomId/repasse
  estornarRepasseGarcom(repasseId)                -> DELETE /relatorio/garcom/repasse/:repasseId
  ```
- Backend controller: `server_delivery/src/restaurante/restaurante.controller.ts:349-373`:
  ```ts
  @Get('relatorio/garcom')
  relatorioGarcom(@Req() req, @Query('de') de, @Query('ate') ate) { return this.service.getRelatorioGarcom(req.restaurantId, de, ate); }

  @Post('relatorio/garcom/:garcomId/repasse')
  registrarRepasseGarcom(@Req() req, @Param('garcomId', ParseIntPipe) garcomId, @Body() body: { de, ate, valor_gorjeta, valor_comissao, valor_dinheiro?, valor_pix? }) { ... }

  @Delete('relatorio/garcom/repasse/:repasseId')
  estornarRepasseGarcom(@Req() req, @Param('repasseId', ParseIntPipe) repasseId) { ... }
  ```
- Backend service: `server_delivery/src/restaurante/restaurante.service.ts`:
  - `getRelatorioGarcom` (lines 2159-2317): queries `garcons` (id, nome by restaurant_id); `orders` filtered `canal='presencial'`, `garcom_id not null`, date range, joins mesas/customers; `garcom_comissoes_lancamentos` (garcom_id, order_id, valor_calculado) for commission; open-comanda counts via `orders.status` in `this.COMANDA_STATUS_ABERTOS`; favorite-product aggregation via `order_items`/`products`; existing repasse lookup from `garcom_repasses` filtered by exact `periodo_de`/`periodo_ate` match; per-order "vendas" detail array (payment info via `this.buscarPagamentosPorComanda(pedidos)`); `garcom_turnos` closed-shift list (NOT needed for motoboy per decision above — skip this part).
  - `registrarRepasseGarcom` (lines 2322-2388): validates `garcom` belongs to restaurant; validates `valor_dinheiro + valor_pix ≈ valor_gorjeta + valor_comissao` (0.01 tolerance); if `valor_dinheiro > 0`, calls `this.adicionarSaida(restaurantId, { descricao, valor, meio: 'dinheiro' })` to create a caixa outflow, capturing `saida.caixa_id`/`saida.criado_em`; inserts into `garcom_repasses`; on insert error with `saidaCaixaId` set, calls `this.removerSaidaPorCriadoEm(restaurantId, saidaCaixaId, saidaCriadoEm)` to roll back the caixa entry; on Postgres unique-violation (`error.code === '23505'`) throws `ConflictException`.
  - `estornarRepasseGarcom` (lines 2393-2410): looks up repasse by id+restaurant_id; if `valor_dinheiro > 0` and has `caixa_id`+`saida_criado_em`, calls `this.removerSaidaPorCriadoEm(...)`; deletes the `garcom_repasses` row.
- Migration: `supabase/migrations/20260727190000_garcom_repasses.sql`:
  ```sql
  CREATE TABLE public.garcom_repasses (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    restaurant_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES public.restaurants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    garcom_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES public.garcons(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    periodo_de TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    periodo_ate TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    valor_gorjeta NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    valor_comissao NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    valor_dinheiro NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    valor_pix NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    caixa_id BIGINT REFERENCES public.caixas(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    saida_criado_em TIMESTAMPTZ,
    pago_em TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    UNIQUE (garcom_id, periodo_de, periodo_ate)
  );
  -- + indexes + RLS policy (owner-only via restaurants.user_id = auth.uid())
  ```
- Nav config: `src/config/restauranteNavLinks.js:3` — `{ label: 'Relatórios', path: '/restaurante/relatorios', icon: 'BarChart3' }` inside `BASE_LINKS`; comment at line 49 also references "Relatórios".

### Motoboy earnings — what exists, to be extended
- Frontend tab structure: `src/pages/motoboy-portal/index.jsx` (983 lines) — NOT router-based, local `useState('pedidos')` (`aba`), tab array around lines 840-854: `[{id:'pedidos',...},{id:'estabelecimentos',...},{id:'ganhos', label:'Ganhos', icon:'Wallet'}]`, content rendered conditionally in `<main>` (~858-966). `AbaGanhos` component defined lines 247-306 (I've read it in full): loads `getGanhosResumo()` + `getGanhosHistorico()` on mount (no period filter currently), renders gradient "Total ganho" card, "Por estabelecimento" list, "Histórico de entregas" list (pedido_id, restaurant name, date, tipo, distancia_km, frete_repassado + adicional, comissao_valor).
- Frontend service: `src/services/motoboyService.js:83-86`:
  ```js
  getGanhosResumo()                -> GET /ganhos
  getGanhosHistorico(restaurantId) -> GET /ganhos/historico?restaurant_id=
  ```
- Backend controller: `server_delivery/src/motoboy/motoboy-portal.controller.ts:25-33` (thin, delegates to service).
- Backend service: `server_delivery/src/motoboy/motoboy.service.ts`:
  - `ganhosResumo(motoboyId)` (lines 1011-1034): NO date filtering at all (sums ALL-TIME); groups `motoboy_comissoes` by restaurant_id, returns `{ resumo: [{restaurant_id, nome, total, entregas}], total_geral }`.
  - `ganhosHistorico(motoboyId, restaurantId?)` (lines 1036-1048): last 100 rows from `motoboy_comissoes`, optional restaurant_id filter, selects `id, restaurant_id, pedido_id, tipo, distancia_km, frete_repassado, valor_base, comissao_valor, status, criado_em, restaurant:restaurants(name)`.
- Commission calc: `server_delivery/src/motoboy/comissao.service.ts` `registrarComissaoEntrega` (lines 25-97) — idempotent via UNIQUE(pedido_id), called when an order is marked delivered. Motoboy always gets `frete_repassado` (= frete_cobrado passed through) + an "adicional" computed per `restaurants.motoboy_comissao_tipo` (`fixo`/`percentual`/`km`, with `km_fallback` when geocoding fails). Writes row to `motoboy_comissoes` WITHOUT setting `status` (defaults) or `pago_em`.
- **IMPORTANT existing schema detail**: migration `supabase/migrations/20260713000006_motoboy_comissoes.sql` already has `status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pendente' CHECK (status IN ('pendente','pago'))` and `pago_em TIMESTAMPTZ` columns on `motoboy_comissoes` — currently completely unused/dead (never updated to 'pago' anywhere in the codebase). This is a strong signal the schema was designed anticipating a payout flow. Consider whether the new repasse feature should (a) mirror garçom exactly with a separate period-level `motoboy_repasses` ledger table (full parity, simplest to reason about, matches user's explicit choice of "igual garçom"), while ALSO (b) bulk-updating the covered `motoboy_comissoes` rows to `status='pago'`/`pago_em=NOW()` when a repasse is registered (and reverting them to 'pendente'/NULL on estorno) — this makes the existing dead columns useful and lets `ganhosResumo`/historico distinguish paid vs pending without extra joins. Decide and justify in the plan whether to include this refinement or keep it minimal/pure-mirror.
- There's also a separate, UNRELATED existing report `relatorioFretes` (`restaurante.service.ts:1835-1904`, exposed as `GET relatorio/fretes?periodo=`, consumed only by a small widget in `src/pages/restaurante-dashboard/index.jsx` — NOT a full page) that groups delivered orders by motoboy and by day using `orders.frete_cobrado` (the fee billed to the customer) — this is a DIFFERENT metric than motoboy's actual earned commission (`motoboy_comissoes.comissao_valor`, which includes markup on top of frete). Do not conflate the two; the new report is about motoboy earnings/commission, not restaurant freight cost accounting. No need to touch or reuse this endpoint.

## Requirements to design

1. **Nav rename**: `src/config/restauranteNavLinks.js` label change; also update `title="Relatórios"` in `restaurante-relatorios/index.jsx` and "Menu Relatórios" sublink label in `RelatorioNav.jsx` for consistency (both currently hardcoded strings per file summaries — plan should note where exactly, agent should verify exact current text via Read before finalizing if needed, but this is a small cosmetic pass).

2. **New restaurant-side Motoboy report** (`/restaurante/relatorios/motoboy`, new card in `RELATORIOS` array + new `SUBLINKS` entry + new Route):
   - New page `src/pages/restaurante-relatorios/Motoboy.jsx`, structurally mirroring `Garcom.jsx` (period filter, per-motoboy summary table, detail table, repasse modal w/ dinheiro+pix split, estorno, print) but WITHOUT the turno/conference section (no motoboy equivalent of `garcom_turnos` needed).
   - New backend endpoints mirroring garçom's 3 exactly: `GET relatorio/motoboy`, `POST relatorio/motoboy/:motoboyId/repasse`, `DELETE relatorio/motoboy/repasse/:repasseId` — same controller file (`restaurante.controller.ts`), same service file (`restaurante.service.ts`), new methods `getRelatorioMotoboy`, `registrarRepasseMotoboy`, `estornarRepasseMotoboy` closely mirroring the garçom versions' logic (reuse `this.adicionarSaida`/`this.removerSaidaPorCriadoEm` the same way).
   - Data model differences vs garçom to account for: motoboys don't have "gorjeta" (tips) or "comandas abertas/produto favorito" concepts — the per-motoboy summary should show entregas count, total comissao (sum of `comissao_valor`), maybe breakdown of frete_repassado vs adicional. No `garcom_comissoes_lancamentos`-equivalent join needed since `motoboy_comissoes.comissao_valor` is already the final per-delivery number (computed once at delivery time, no restaurant.motoboy_id join complexity — it's motoboys table, not garcons, but structurally analogous: `motoboys(id, name, ...)` — verify exact column name for the display name, I believe it's `name` not `nome` based on `restaurant:restaurants(name)` pattern seen elsewhere and `motoboys(name)` join in `relatorioFretes`).
   - New migration `supabase/migrations/<timestamp>_motoboy_repasses.sql` mirroring `garcom_repasses` structure: `motoboy_repasses(id, restaurant_id, motoboy_id REFERENCES motoboys(id), periodo_de, periodo_ate, valor_comissao, valor_dinheiro, valor_pix, caixa_id, saida_criado_em, pago_em, UNIQUE(motoboy_id, periodo_de, periodo_ate))` — no `valor_gorjeta` column needed (motoboys have no tips).
   - New frontend service functions in `restauranteService.js` mirroring the garçom ones exactly (`getRelatorioMotoboy`, `registrarRepasseMotoboy`, `estornarRepasseMotoboy`).

3. **Motoboy portal "Financeiro" tab** (rename+expand existing "Ganhos" tab, same `aba` id can change from `'ganhos'` to `'financeiro'` or keep id and just change label — plan should decide, keeping URL/state stable is preferable since it's not router-based):
   - Extend `ganhosResumo`/`ganhosHistorico` (or add new endpoint(s)) to support optional `de`/`ate` date-range params and add a `por_dia` daily breakdown (mirroring the `por_dia` grouping pattern already used in `relatorioFretes`, lines ~1885-1894, for consistency of style) so the motoboy can see "produção diária" (today's deliveries/earnings, and recent days).
   - Frontend: extend `AbaGanhos` (rename component/tab label to "Financeiro") to add a "hoje"/daily production section, reusing the existing gradient-card and list-item visual patterns already in that component.
   - Decide: is a period filter UI needed (like `FiltroPeriodo.jsx` used in restaurant reports), or is "today + recent days list" sufficient per the user's stated need ("ir acompanhando a produção diária")? Lean toward simple — default view emphasizes "hoje", plus the existing full-history list stays as-is below it. Avoid over-building a full period-filter UI on a small mobile screen unless clearly needed.

## Constraints
- Follow existing code style exactly (Portuguese variable/comment names, existing component patterns, Tailwind class conventions already used in these files — no new UI libraries).
- Must work identically across both backend checkouts (server_delivery submodule + serer_delivery standalone) — same file changes applied to both, this is a known project workflow, just note it as a step, don't need to design around it.
- RLS policy for the new table must follow the same owner-check pattern as `garcom_repasses`.
- Do not touch `garcom_turnos`/conference-acceptance concept for motoboy — explicitly out of scope per user decision.

## What I need from you
A concrete, file-by-file implementation plan (which files to create/edit, what changes in each, in what order) that I can hand to an implementer. Flag any remaining open design decisions or risks you spot (e.g., the `motoboy_comissoes.status`/`pago_em` refinement question above) rather than silently picking one — I'll make the final call, but give your recommendation.

## Verified ground truth (beyond what was already summarized)

- `src/config/restauranteNavLinks.js:3` — exact line to change: `{ label: 'Relatórios', path: '/restaurante/relatorios', icon: 'BarChart3' }`. Line 49 has only a comment (`// Dashboard, Relatórios`), not a string used in the UI — optional to update, cosmetic-only in code comments.

- `src/pages/restaurante-relatorios/index.jsx:38` — `<RestauranteHeader active="/restaurante/relatorios" title="Relatórios" />`.
- `src/pages/restaurante-dashboard/RelatorioPanel.jsx:171` — a **different**, unrelated "Relatórios" heading (dashboard collapsible widget title, not sidebar/nav). Out of scope for the rename per the confirmed requirement (sidebar label only); flagging in case the user wants full-app consistency, but not planning to touch it.
- `motoboys` table (`20260607000003_motoboys.sql`): columns `id, restaurant_id, name, phone, access_token, is_active, created_at`. Display name column is confirmed **`name`** (not `nome`), consistent with `relatorioFretes`'s `motoboys(name)` join.
- **Important correction to the ticket's assumption**: motoboys are NOT restaurant-scoped like `garcons`. Migration `20260713000003_motoboy_estabelecimentos.sql` introduced an N:N affiliation table `motoboy_estabelecimentos(motoboy_id, restaurant_id, status, bloqueado, ...)`, and `20260820000001_motoboys_gerenciados_pelo_restaurante.sql` added `motoboys.criado_por_restaurant_id`. A given motoboy can be affiliated with several restaurants. `motoboy.service.ts` (`listarSolicitacoes`, `bloquearAfiliacao`, `removerAfiliacao`) shows the established pattern for "motoboys belonging to this restaurant": query `motoboy_estabelecimentos` filtered `restaurant_id = X AND status = 'aceito'`, joined to `motoboys(id, name)`. **This is the correct source for pre-seeding the per-motoboy summary table** (analogous to how `getRelatorioGarcom` pre-seeds from the full `garcons` table) — not a naive `motoboys.eq('restaurant_id', X)` query, which would miss/incorrectly-include motoboys based on stale legacy data.
- `motoboy_comissoes` columns confirmed via `ganhosHistorico`: `id, restaurant_id, motoboy_id, pedido_id, tipo, distancia_km, frete_repassado, valor_base, comissao_valor, status, criado_em, pago_em`. `status` defaults `'pendente'`, check constraint `('pendente','pago')`, currently never written to `'pago'` anywhere (confirmed dead).
- `adicionarSaida(restaurantId, { descricao, valor, meio })` and `removerSaidaPorCriadoEm(restaurantId, caixaId, criadoEm)` are private/instance methods already on `RestauranteService` (`restaurante.service.ts:1755` and `:1790`) — directly reusable by the new motoboy repasse methods in the same class, no new plumbing needed.
- `relatorioFretes` (lines 1835-1904) is the existing style reference for a `por_dia` grouping block (`Record<string, {dia, ...}>` keyed by `toLocaleDateString('pt-BR', {day:'2-digit',month:'2-digit',year:'numeric'})`) — good pattern to mirror for the motoboy portal's daily-production breakdown.
- `FiltroPeriodo.jsx` and `relatorioPrint.js` (`fmt`, `buildRange`, `printIframe`, `reportBaseStyle`, `printFooterScript`, `defaultFiltroState`, `MODOS`, `ANOS`) are generic/reusable, no report-specific logic baked in — safe to import as-is into `Motoboy.jsx`.
- `motoboy-portal/index.jsx`'s `AbaGanhos` (lines 247-307) has no period filter; loads `getGanhosResumo()` + `getGanhosHistorico()` once on mount. `motoboyFetch` in `motoboyService.js` already handles Supabase-session bearer auth, matching pattern to extend.
- `MotoboyPortalController` (`motoboy-portal.controller.ts`) is thin and delegates directly to `MotoboyService`; `GET /ganhos` and `GET /ganhos/historico` map straight to `ganhosResumo`/`ganhosHistorico`.

## Open design decisions (recommendations, final call is yours)

1. **`motoboy_comissoes.status`/`pago_em` refinement** — Recommend **doing it**, not just the pure mirror. Rationale: these columns already exist, are indexed for it via `criado_em DESC`, and doing the bulk update makes `ganhosResumo`/`ganhosHistorico` able to show "pago" vs "pendente" per line without an extra join to `motoboy_repasses`, and gives the motoboy visibility into what's already been settled — directly useful for the new "Financeiro" tab. Implementation: in `registrarRepasseMotoboy`, after the `motoboy_repasses` insert succeeds, bulk `UPDATE motoboy_comissoes SET status='pago', pago_em=NOW() WHERE motoboy_id=? AND restaurant_id=? AND criado_em BETWEEN de AND ate`; in `estornarRepasseMotoboy`, bulk-revert `SET status='pendente', pago_em=NULL` for the same filter (need to store `periodo_de`/`periodo_ate` on the repasse row, which the mirrored schema already does, to know which rows to revert — read them from the repasse row before deleting it). This is pure a additive parallel bookkeeping; if it fails/is skipped it does not affect the repasse ledger's correctness (the `motoboy_repasses` row/caixa entry remain the source of truth), so treat it as best-effort (log but don't throw on failure) to avoid a new failure mode in the payout flow.
2. **Summary-table population source** — Recommend `motoboy_estabelecimentos` (status='aceito') joined to `motoboys(id,name)` scoped to the restaurant, NOT `motoboys.restaurant_id`, per the correction above. Also filter out `bloqueado = true`? Recommend **not** filtering out blocked motoboys from the report — a blocked motoboy may still have unpaid commissions from before the block, and the owner needs to see/pay them. Only exclude `status != 'aceito'` (pendente/recusado/removido never had a working relationship).
3. **Financeiro tab period filter UI** — Recommend **no** `FiltroPeriodo`-style UI on mobile; instead extend `ganhosResumo` to accept nothing extra but add a `hoje: { entregas, total }` block computed server-side (server's "today" in `America/Sao_Paulo`), and extend `ganhosHistorico` (or a new endpoint) with a `por_dia` array (last ~14 days) for a compact sparkline/list. Keep the existing full all-time `resumo`/`historico` sections as-is below it. This matches the user's stated need ("ir acompanhando a produção diária") without over-building.
4. **Tab id** — Recommend keeping the `aba` state id as `'ganhos'` internally (avoids touching the tab-switch logic/effects keyed on that id) and only changing the **label** shown to `'Financeiro'` and the icon if desired. Since it's not router-based there's no URL to preserve either way, so this is purely to minimize the diff — flag this as an option; alternatively rename the id to `'financeiro'` for internal consistency/readability, at the cost of a couple extra find-replace touches in the same file. Either is safe; recommend the id rename (`'financeiro'`) for future-proofing since this is a small file and it reads better than a residual `'ganhos'` id under a "Financeiro" label — implementer's call.

1. `src/config/restauranteNavLinks.js` — line 3: change `label: 'Relatórios'` to `label: 'Conferências'`. (Icon/path unchanged — cosmetic only, confirmed no route change needed.)

3. `src/pages/restaurante-relatorios/index.jsx` — line 38: change `title="Relatórios"` to `title="Conferências"`.
4. Leave `RelatorioPanel.jsx:171` and any per-report page headers (`Relatório — Garçom`, etc. in `RelatorioNav.jsx:23`) untouched — those are report-specific labels, not the sidebar item, and out of the confirmed scope.
